definitions.explanation: A physiological condition resulting from rapid travel across time zones, causing fatigue, disorientation, and disrupted sleep patterns.

examples.japanese: {時差|じさ}ボケで{眠|ねむ}れない。
examples.english: I can't sleep because of jet lag.

examples.japanese: アメリカから{帰|かえ}ってきて、{一週間|いっしゅうかん}も{時差|じさ}ボケが{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: After returning from America, my jet lag lasted for a whole week.

notes:
A compound of {時差|じさ} (time difference) and ボケ (daze, disorientation). Very commonly used by Japanese travelers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時差|じさ}ボケになる (to get jet lag)
- {時差|じさ}ボケが{治|なお}る (to recover from jet lag)
- {時差|じさ}ボケを{解消|かいしょう}する (to overcome jet lag)
- {時差|じさ}ボケ{対策|たいさく} (jet lag countermeasures)

RELATED TERMS:
- {時差|じさ}: time difference
- ボケる: to become dazed/confused
- {睡眠|すいみん}{障害|しょうがい}: sleep disorder
